西风村，中央祠堂外。

漫天灰雾凝滞不动，寒风骤停，整片空间陷入诡异死寂。

那道隐匿在雾气深处的阴阳师身影，静静伫立祠堂台阶之上。一身纯黑狩衣，衣摆绣着暗金色诡异纹路，宽大衣袖遮没手掌，唯有一双狭长阴冷的眸子，穿透层层雾气，冷漠凝视众人。

他手中握着一枚老旧青铜招魂铃，铃身斑驳，刻满东瀛阴文，方才那一声铃响，便是出自此铃。

铃音控魂，引阴驱煞。

被操控的七道村民亡魂，此刻全部抬起惨白脸庞，空洞眼窝没有丝毫神采，僵硬身躯缓缓转向小队众人，四肢扭曲，骨骼发出咯吱刺耳的摩擦声。

死气弥漫，寒意刺骨。

“是东瀛阴阳师。”林佳压低声音，快速冷静分析，“孤身一人，站位靠后，应该是外围驻守的低级咒师，负责看守村落阴阵，排查闯入者。”

范梦雪手握雷木法尺，周身雷光隐隐跳动，银色雷芒在灰暗雾气之中格外刺眼：“阴阳师擅长控魂、式神、咒印、招魂铃，此人以亡魂为兵，以铃音为令，想要凭借七道残魂拖住我们。”

雾气之中，那名阴阳师缓缓抬手，没有开口说话，声音直接透过阴煞雾气传入众人耳中，生硬拗口，带着一股冰冷的异域语调。

“外来修士，退。”

简简单单一个字，冷硬傲慢，带着毫不掩饰的敌意与轻蔑。

在他眼中，这群突然闯入荒村的华夏修士，不过是打乱阵法、不知死活的闯入者。

胡九郎黑衣直立，身姿孤挺，嘴角勾起一抹极淡的冷弧：“华夏山河，中土大地，何时轮得到域外邪祟下令驱赶？”

话音落下，他指尖一弹，那枚温热铜钱破空飞出，在空中急速旋转，铜钱表面卦纹金光一闪，直逼雾中阴阳师。

“冥顽不灵。”

阴阳师冷哼一声，袖袍一挥，黑雾陡然涌出，化作一面漆黑雾墙，硬生生挡下飞来铜钱。

当——

铜钱撞击黑雾，发出清脆闷响，金光炸裂，黑雾溃散一片。

与此同时，阴阳师再次摇动青铜招魂铃。

叮——叮——

两声铃响，高低错落，阴冷诡谲。

七道惨白亡魂瞬间躁动起来，僵硬四肢扭曲发力，脚下冻土碎裂，朝着众人狂奔而来。空洞面孔毫无表情，却透着一股疯狂嗜血的阴冷戾气。

“队形不变，各司其职！”林佳沉声喝道。

王欣欣、茉沫率先动身，身形一闪，掠至两侧土墙之上。

刷刷刷！

数十枚淬毒银针、透骨飞镖破空而出，精准刺入亡魂四肢关节。唐门暗器专破阴邪气脉，针身沾染杨瑞特制的破煞药粉，触碰到亡魂黑雾的瞬间，白烟四起，阴魂剧烈颤抖。

“这些亡魂被阵法固化，不死不灭，只能暂时压制。”王欣欣冷声开口，“不要浪费杀伤力，切断它们行动轨迹即可。”

茉沫手腕翻转，银色软索甩出，缠绕两道亡魂脖颈，用力一勒，黑雾震荡，硬生生将狂奔的亡魂拽停在原地。

李安琪指尖金芒暴涨，脚下冻土裂开，无数尖锐石刺破土而出，交错形成石墙，拦住剩余亡魂去路。金石至阳，天生克制阴魂，亡魂撞上石墙，黑雾灼烧，发出凄厉无声的嘶吼。

钱丹袖中飞出数只通体雪白的清心蛊，小虫浮空，散发出淡淡柔光，柔和净化周遭阴煞雾气，削弱招魂铃的控魂之力。

杨瑞抬手抛出四枚漆黑法牌，落地结成简易镇魂结界，护住小队周身，隔绝阴冷煞气侵入。

众人配合行云流水，短短瞬息之间，便将七道亡魂死死困住，无法再前进一步。

Xifeng Village, outside the Central Ancestral Hall.

The sky was full of gray fog, the cold wind suddenly stopped, and the entire space fell into an eerie silence.

The figure of the Onmyoji hidden deep in the mist stood quietly on the steps of the ancestral hall.Wearing a pure black hunting coat, the hem was embroidered with dark gold strange patterns, and the wide sleeves covered his palms. Only a pair of narrow and cold eyes penetrated the layers of fog and stared at everyone indifferently.

He held an old bronze soul-calling bell in his hand. The bell was mottled and engraved with Japanese inscriptions. The ringing sound just now came from this bell.

The sound of the bell controls the soul, attracts yin and drives away evil spirits.

The seven ghosts of the villagers who were controlled now all raised their pale faces, with empty eye sockets without any expression. Their stiff bodies slowly turned towards the team, their limbs were twisted, and their bones made a creaking and harsh friction sound.

The air of death permeated the air, and the chill was biting.

"It's the Japanese Onmyoji." Lin Jia lowered her voice and analyzed quickly and calmly, "He is alone and standing at the back. He should be a low-level spell master stationed on the outside. He is responsible for guarding the village's Yin Formation and checking for intruders."

Fan Mengxue held the Thunderwood Ruler in her hand, and the lightning around her body was faintly beating. The silver lightning was particularly dazzling in the gray mist: "Onmyoji is good at controlling souls, shikigami, curse seals, and soul summoning bells. This person uses dead souls as his soldiers and the sound of the bell as his command. He wants to use the seven residual souls to hold us back."

In the mist, the Onmyoji slowly raised his hand and did not speak. His voice was directly transmitted to everyone's ears through the Yin evil mist. He spoke stiffly and had a cold, foreign tone.

"Foreign monks, retreat."

A simple word, cold and arrogant, with undisguised hostility and contempt.

In his eyes, this group of Chinese monks who suddenly broke into the deserted village were just intruders who disrupted the formation and did not care about life and death.

Hu Jiulang stood upright in black clothes, with a straight posture, and a faint cold arc appeared at the corner of his mouth: "When will the mountains and rivers of China, and the land of China, get the order to drive away the evil spirits from outside the territory?"

After he finished speaking, he flicked his fingertips, and the warm copper coin flew out of the air, spinning rapidly in the air. The golden hexagram pattern on the surface of the copper coin flashed, heading towards the Onmyoji in the fog.

"Stubborn."

The Onmyoji snorted coldly, waved his sleeves, and black mist suddenly gushes out, turning into a wall of pitch black mist, blocking the flying coins.

When——

The copper coins hit the black fog, making a crisp and muffled sound, the golden light exploded, and the black fog collapsed.

At the same time, Onmyoji shook the bronze soul-calling bell again.

Ding——ding——

Two bells rang, high and low, cold and eerie.

The seven pale dead souls instantly became restless, their stiff limbs twisted and exerted force, the frozen soil beneath their feet shattered, and they ran towards the crowd.The empty face was expressionless, but it exuded a cold and vicious aura of crazy bloodthirsty.

"The formation remains unchanged, everyone performs their duties!" Lin Jia shouted in a deep voice.

Wang Xinxin and Mo Mo took the lead, and in a flash, they reached the earth walls on both sides.

Swish, brush, brush!

Dozens of poison-quenching silver needles and bone-penetrating darts shot out of the air, accurately piercing the limbs and joints of the dead soul.The Tang Sect's hidden weapon is designed to break the evil energy veins. The needle body is contaminated with Yang Rui's special evil-breaking medicine powder. The moment it touches the black mist of the dead soul, white smoke rises and the ghost trembles violently.

"These dead souls are solidified by the formation and are immortal. They can only be temporarily suppressed." Wang Xinxin said coldly, "Don't waste the lethality, just cut off their trajectory."

Momo flipped her wrist and threw out the silver soft rope, wrapping it around the necks of the two dead souls and squeezing them hard. The black mist vibrated and forcibly stopped the running dead souls in place.

The golden light on Li Anqi's fingertips skyrocketed, and the frozen soil beneath his feet cracked. Countless sharp stone thorns burst out of the soil, staggering to form a stone wall, blocking the path of the remaining souls.Gold and stone are the sun, naturally restraining the ghosts. The dead souls hit the stone wall, the black mist burned, and they let out a shrill and silent roar.

Several snow-white Qingxin Gu flew out of Qian Dan's sleeves. The small insects floated in the air, emitting a faint soft light, softly purifying the surrounding evil mist and weakening the soul-controlling power of the soul-calling bell.

Yang Rui raised his hand and threw four pitch-black magic cards, which formed a simple soul-suppressing barrier when they landed, protecting the whole team and blocking the cold and evil energy from invading.

Everyone cooperated, and in just a short moment, seven dead souls were trapped, unable to move forward any further.
